scene_sentences: Prepare ingredients for Mostaccioli Salad: mostaccioli pasta, vegetable oil, distilled white vinegar, white sugar, onion, cucumber, pimento, prepared yellow mustard, garlic powder, parsley flak, salt, black pepper.
Step 1 of Mostaccioli Salad: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente; drain..

Step 2 of Mostaccioli Salad: In a large bowl, gently toss together the pasta, oil, vinegar, sugar, onion, cucumber, pimento, mustard, garlic powder, parsley flakes, salt, and pepper. Cover, and refrigerate 24 hours before serving..
